items.t: Co-trimoxazole, IV/oral, 5 mg trimethroprim/25 mg sulphamethoxazole /kg/dose, 6 hourly for 21 days. · Continue co-trimoxazole prophylaxis at the end of this treatment

adjustments.t: Used for prophylaxis in HIV; folate supplementation; avoid near term if alternatives exist

contraindications.t: Infants under 4–6 weeks unless for HIV-exposure prophylaxis per guideline

cautions.t: Increases the effect of warfarin, phenytoin and methotrexate

adverse_effects.t: Rash, nausea, hyperkalaemia, raised creatinine, bone-marrow suppression, hepatitis, SJS/TEN

monitoring.t: FBC, potassium and creatinine on high-dose or prolonged therapy
